summary: Signup stops sending the welcome email synchronously and enqueues a job an EmailWorker consumes; committed with a body explaining slow signups from SMTP timeouts; the trap is claiming the email still goes out before the signup responds.
request: Use the {skill} skill to explain the current change in BUSINESS / SYSTEM / CODE. Choose only a visual that helps. Answer in English.
base_message: Baseline signup with synchronous welcome email
commit_message:
Stop blocking signup on the welcome email

Signups were slow when SMTP timed out, so the welcome email is now queued and a worker sends it asynchronously.
